en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large cobblestoned market square bordered by several classical and late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left is a neoclassical building with columns; to the right are multi‑storey townhouses and a larger building with a triangular pediment. The scene is mostly empty, with just a few small figures in the distance. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the marketplace with Hotel Zehr in Mitau.
